sections.section_title: ADC analog watchdog 2 higher threshold register (ADC_AWD2HTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 21.6.24 "ADC analog watchdog 2 higher threshold register (ADC_AWD2HTR)" in chapter 21 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 661.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0B4
Reset value: 0x003F FFFF
Bits 31:23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:0 HTR[22:0]: Analog watchdog 2 higher threshold
These bits are set and cleared by software to define the higher threshold for analog watchdog 2.
Refer to Analog windows watchdog section.
